items.title: Your Guide to the Developer Tools Track at AWS re:Invent 2026
items.summary: AWS re:Invent 2026 is almost here, and if you’re a developer, the Developer Tools (DVT) track is where you’ll want to spend your week. This year is all about agentic development, from multi-agent workflows to autonomous agents that keep working while you sleep. And CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and full-stack development are still well represented. […]
items.creator: Brian Beach

items.title: Run Maestro tests on real Android devices using AWS Device Farm
items.summary: Learn how ManoMano runs Maestro mobile UI tests on real Android devices using the AWS Device Farm custom test environment. This post covers packaging your YAML flows, configuring the test spec, installing the Maestro CLI, handling manufacturer-specific device restrictions, and automating the workflow in your CI/CD pipeline.
items.creator: Ronald Teijeira Fernandez
